acceptance: Databricks gateway connection options reach the adapter and fail closed on bad host/TLS settings
run --platform databricks --gateway espresso|custom is accepted and labelled routed (unofficial_nonstandard), with tests
description: The Databricks adapter forwards only the `gateway` key (benchbox/platforms/databricks/adapter.py from_config key list), so gateway connection options registered for Databricks are silently dropped; for this reason GATEWAY_ROUTED_PLATFORMS in benchbox/core/gateway.py stays Snowflake-only and `run --platform databricks --gateway espresso|custom` fails closed. Forward the options, validate them as the Snowflake adapter does, then add databricks to GATEWAY_ROUTED_PLATFORMS.
